title: Scale-out worked; our laptop hit its limit first
notes: Standard ramp (5 to 55 users): 99.99% availability, CPU at most 11%, so no scale-out was needed. Heavy ramp (150 to 450 users) with the CPU target lowered from 50% to 30% during the run: the Auto Scaling Group went 2 to 3 at 19:37:06 and 3 to 4 at 19:38:06 with no human action, and throughput rose from about 305 to 370 req/s while CPU per instance fell. But the load generator on one laptop saturated at about 300 req/s: almost all errors are client-side timeouts, so the p95 under 500 ms criterion cannot be judged fairly. At peak, one overloaded instance failed its health check; its first replacement was refused by the new account's vCPU quota and succeeded on retry a minute later.
